story.en: The parade starts at 07:00 on Panganiban Drive by Ninoy and Cory Avenue, crosses the bridge and loops south on Dinaga, west on Caceres (Padian), north on General Luna, east on Kinastillohan and back down Elias Angeles, then turns up Peñafrancia Avenue and along P. Burgos to the Plaza Quezon stage. The 72 contingents recall the documented 2023 gathering. Uniform colors, six bands, block sizes and the three-hour replay are illustrative; the latter follows the dated 2023 event window.

sources.title: Philippine Information Agency: 72 contingents in 2023
sources.note: Reports 72 contingents in the September 15, 2023 competition; this does not assert the same count in every year.

sources.title: City of Naga: 2023 parade event window
sources.note: The September 15, 2023 event lists 07:00–10:00. The 2026 start remains 07:00; the replay length is illustrative.
